scene.head: tilt
scene.placeText: the very top of the great steel arch of the harbour bridge in her steam city on a bright morning — rows of polished rivets and a brass handrail, a little brass rivet forge glowing beside her, the paddle-steamer ferries, the sail-roofed hall and the terrace-house hills far below
scene.ownProp: a polished brass riveting hammer with a turned wooden handle
scene.outfit: a rivet-keeper look fitted to her body — a sleeveless iron-grey waistcoat-corset crossed by a riveted brass arch lattice over her bust, high-waisted work shorts, a slim leather tool belt, fingerless leather gloves, brass goggles on her head, square granite-and-brass wrist cuffs and laced boots
scene.scene: she is a rivet keeper of the great arch, kneeling on the steel to set a glowing rivet with her brass hammer and checking each one along the arch before the morning ferries pass beneath
